joint_temporal_refinement.scope: All times jointly refined with actual multicamera masks and temporal matrix-rotation/translation second-difference penalties; fixed smoothed silhouette hull and scale. No invented object observations, no attachment to hands/head, no exact physical dynamics or orientation truth. Temporal priors regularize poorly observed frames, including frame7. Resolution256 objective is not directly comparable to prior384 metrics.
